title: Crispy Fried Cutlets: SBP Variations, Crumbs, and Frying Techniques
summary: This Techniquely episode outlines the standard breading procedure (SBP) for crispy fried cutlets and dives into practical variations used across tonkatsu, schnitzel, and chicken parmigiana. It breaks down the three-part coating (flour, egg wash, breadcrumbs), explains how crumb size, type, and seasonings affect texture and flavor, and presents tweaks to boost crust integrity (Parmesan in crumbs for water resistance, egg-wash adjustments, batter-leaning approaches). The host then covers frying strategies tailored to meat thickness (shallow frying with a 2/3 oil depth, straight-sided pans), how to manage batter adhesion with a dry hand/wet hand method, and techniques to prevent crust collapse or cupping (perforating fat/silver skin, resting cuts on their side). The episode also shares methods for easier execution for those who fry infrequently, crumb-pressing tips, and finishing touches for each dish (schnitzel, tonkatsu, chicken parmesan) followed by a recap of how SBP can vary to distinguish similar fried dishes while maintaining crisp texture.
